name: chemicals
description: Chemicals and Substances: from a substance name, CAS/EC number or InChIKey to its reviewable identity, harmonised (CLP Annex VI) and notified classifications with every ATP revision, REACH registration status, SVHC Candidate List and Annex XIV/XVII entries over time, and published toxicity data points - each with source, revision and as-of time - linked by citation to the legal acts, product safety notices, materials and literature that cite it.

query_examples.intent: Which substances does this CAS number reach
query_examples.semantics: exact identifier with verified check digits; records join only through accepted identity decisions, and each match is returned with its basis and reviewer

query_examples.intent: Classification and restriction status on a date
query_examples.semantics: the harmonised classification and list entries in force on the date, each with the ATP or amending act that set it; later revisions are scheduled; none on record is never 'safe'
identity, status, history, regulation text by citation, linked notices and published data points quoted as the source's data
